title: Final Probability
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct probability P_1 for the molecule being in the first excited vibrational state.

title: Final Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct ratio of N(J = 0) to N(J = 1) for the rotational states.

title: Hamiltonian Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the Hamiltonian for both vibrational and rotational motion.

title: Energy State Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct energy state equations for vibrational and rotational states.

title: Parameter Estimates
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately estimate and define all necessary parameters such as reduced mass and spring constant.

title: Exponential Factor
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show the correct use of the exponential factor in calculating probabilities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Boltzmann factor.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any critical factors in the calculations, such as the degeneracy factor in rotational states.
